newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: OAU urges U.N. troops to be sent to Congo Republic.
newsitem.headline: OAU urges U.N. troops to be sent to Congo Republic.

text.p: The Organisation of African Unity appealed on Tuesday to the U.N. Security Council to send a peacekeeping force to the Republic of Congo.
The OAU body responsible for conflict prevention, management and resolution made the appeal in a statement, saying the situation was serious and could affect peace in the region.
It expressed grave concern over continued violations of a ceasefire and appealed to all concerned parties to adhere to terms of the ceasefire agreements.
It appealed to Africans and non-Africans to support mediation by President Omar Bongo of Gabon.
Last week, battles between forces loyal to Congolese President Pascal Lissouba and his predecessor Denis Sassou Nguesso forced thousands more people to flee the capital Brazzaville.
The United Nations backs proposals for an African peacekeeping force but wants a real end to hostilities before it is sent in.
